constitutional_identity.rule: True body replacement never creates a new organism and never transfers organism identity to the body.

old_body.body_instance_id: must exist and be ATTACHED before replacement
old_body.attachment_generation: must match Embodiment occupancy and all current body references
old_body.self_model: old body schema is archived and inactive after replacement

new_body.body_instance_id: a newly generated identifier distinct from the old body_instance_id
new_body.body_profile_id: resolved from the existing qualified profile registry
new_body.capability_support: begins UNKNOWN under existing SelfModel bootstrap semantics; no old-body support is transferred

operation_distinctions.compatible_profile_swap: same body_instance_id, generation + 1, same SelfModel binding/schema
operation_distinctions.temporary_detach_reattach: same body_instance_id, each transition advances generation, no new SelfModel body
operation_distinctions.true_body_replacement: new body_instance_id, generation + 1, new SelfModel binding/schema, one atomic replacement event
operation_distinctions.restart: preserves the currently authoritative body instance and SelfModel binding/schema

historical_evidence: Old-body history remains durable and schema-tagged but grants no authority to the new body.
